records.question: How many customers are there?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers;

records.question: How many tracks are there in total?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tracks FROM tracks;

records.question: List the names of all genres.
records.sql: SELECT GenreName FROM Genres;

records.question: What are the first and last names of the customers from Brazil?
records.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customers WHERE Country = 'Brazil';

records.question: Show the names and lengths in milliseconds of the 5 longest tracks.
records.sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM tracks ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5;

records.question: How many invoices were issued in 2023?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2023' LIMIT 50

records.question: What is the average invoice total, rounded to 2 decimal places?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(InvoiceTotal), 2) AS AverageInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice;
records.error: QueryError: OperationalError: no such column: InvoiceTotal

records.question: What are the first and last names of the employees whose title is 'Sales Support Agent'?
records.sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent' LIMIT 50

records.question: How many different countries do the customers come from?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) AS NumberOfCountries FROM Customers;

records.question: List the names of all media types.
records.sql: SELECT MediaTypeName FROM MediaTypes;

records.question: How many albums are there?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM albums;

records.question: How many tracks cost more than 0.99?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_tracks_over_0_99 FROM tracks WHERE UnitPrice > 0.99;

records.question: What is the largest invoice total?
records.sql: SELECT MAX(InvoiceTotal) AS LargestInvoiceTotal FROM Invoice;
records.error: QueryError: OperationalError: no such column: InvoiceTotal

records.question: How many customers have no company listed?
What is the earliest hire date among the employees?
records.sql: SELECT MIN(HireDate) AS EarliestHireDate FROM Employee LIMIT 50

records.question: What are the titles of all albums by AC/DC?
records.sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album AS a JOIN Artist AS ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC' LIMIT 50

records.question: How many tracks does each genre have? Show the genre name and the track count.
records.sql: SELECT g.Name AS GenreName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre AS g LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name LIMIT 50

records.question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spending? Show first name, last name and total spent.
records.sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: What is the total revenue for each year? Show the year and the revenue.
records.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 50

records.question: How many customers does each support representative have? Show the representative's first name, last name and the number of customers.
records.sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee AS e LEFT JOIN Customer AS c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName LIMIT 50

records.question: Which 5 artists have the most albums? Show the artist name and the number of albums.
records.sql: SELECT a.Name AS ArtistName, COUNT(DISTINCT al.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist AS a JOIN Album AS al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: Which tracks are in the playlist named 'Grunge'? Show the track names.
records.sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track AS t JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN Playlist AS p ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge' LIMIT 50

records.question: Which genres have more than 100 tracks? Show the genre name and the track count.
records.sql: SELECT g.Name AS GenreName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Track AS t JOIN Genre AS g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) > 100 LIMIT 50

records.question: List each album by Iron Maiden with its number of tracks. Show the album title and the track count.
records.sql: SELECT a.Title AS AlbumTitle, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Album AS a JOIN Artist AS ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track AS t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden' GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title ORDER BY a.Title LIMIT 50

records.question: Which employees report to Nancy Edwards? Show their first and last names.
What is the total amount spent by customers from each country? Show the country and the total.
records.sql: SELECT BillingCountry AS country, SUM(Total) AS total_spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry LIMIT 50

records.question: How many tracks are there for each media type? Show the media type name and the track count.
records.sql: SELECT mt.Name AS MediaTypeName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name LIMIT 50

records.question: Which genre has the most tracks? Show the genre name and the track count.
records.sql: SELECT g.Name AS GenreName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Track AS t JOIN Genre AS g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How much has the customer Luis Rojas spent in total?
records.sql: SELECT SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.FirstName = 'Luis' AND c.LastName = 'Rojas' LIMIT 50

records.question: How many tracks does the artist Metallica have?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Artist AS a JOIN Album AS al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track AS t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE a.Name = 'Metallica' LIMIT 50

records.question: Who is the best-selling artist by revenue? Show the artist name and the total revenue.
records.sql: SELECT a.Name AS Artist, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue FROM InvoiceLine AS il JOIN Track AS t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Album AS al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist AS a ON al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What are the top 3 genres by total revenue? Show the genre name and the revenue.
records.sql:
SELECT g.Name AS Genre, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS Revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
JOIN Genre g ON a.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;
records.error: QueryError: OperationalError: no such column: a.GenreId

records.question: Which customers have spent more than the average customer? Show their first and last names.
records.sql:
SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
HAVING SUM(i.InvoiceTotal) > (
    SELECT AVG(total) FROM (
        SELECT CustomerId, SUM(InvoiceTotal) AS total
        FROM Invoice
        GROUP BY CustomerId
    )
);
records.error: QueryError: OperationalError: no such column: i.InvoiceTotal

records.question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS tracks_never_purchased
FROM Tracks t
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
WHERE il.InvoiceLineId IS NULL;

records.question: Which sales support employee's customers generated the most revenue? Show the employee's first name, last name and the total revenue.
records.sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue FROM Employee AS e JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine AS ii ON ii.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Which customers have bought at least one Jazz track? Show their first and last names.
records.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track AS t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre AS g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz' LIMIT 50

records.question: What percentage of the total revenue comes from invoices billed to the USA? Round to 2 decimal places.
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN BillingCountry = 'USA' THEN Total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(Total), 2) AS PercentageFromUSA FROM Invoice LIMIT 50

records.question: Which albums have more than 20 tracks? Show the album title and the track count.
records.sql: SELECT a.Title, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Album AS a JOIN Track AS t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) > 20 LIMIT 50

records.question: Which playlists contain at least one track by AC/DC? Show the playlist names without duplicates.
records.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.Name
FROM Playlist p
JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId
JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Artist a ON t.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
WHERE a.Name = 'AC/DC';
records.error: QueryError: OperationalError: no such column: t.ArtistId

records.question: Who are the top 2 customers by spending on Rock tracks? Show first name, last name and the amount spent.
records.sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track AS t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre AS g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock' GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 2
